title: Landslide

sources.label: Lauren Bateman, Landslide chords & guitar lesson (intro and verse: C, G/B, Am, G/B)
Capo 3 chord chart by P_Trik (Ultimate Guitar, via the Penultimate Guitar mirror): C x32010, G/B x20033, Am7 x02010

notes: Lauren Bateman writes the third chord as Am; the capo 3 chart's shape is Am7 (x02010), one finger different. Neither gives bar lengths, so it's one chord per bar here: check the timing by ear. Only the intro and verse figure is charted.

picking.description: Travis style, as you play it: the thumb alternates between two bass strings on every beat, and i and m pluck treble strings on the off-beats. Usually played with a capo, using C-shape chords; verify the exact strings, order and capo by ear.
